learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic operating principles of radio and television systems.
Compares and analyzes television standards and scanning techniques.
Analyzes the structure and operating principles of radio receivers.
Evaluates the effects of noise, interference, and signal distortions on communication systems.
Applies and designs basic circuit and receiver structures used in radio and television systems.
Shows sensitivity to the importance of quality and performance criteria in communication systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to color television systems and basic concepts
Operating principles of color television systems
Basic structure and block diagram of radio receivers
Frequency adjustment and tuning circuits in receivers
Basic principles of stereo radio receivers
FM stereo broadcasting and receiver structure
